latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Agora skill for real-time voice, video, AI, and related integrations.

- Supports all core Agora products: RTC, RTM, Conversational AI (voice agents), Cloud Recording, Server-side token generation, Server Gateway SDK, and multi-product integration patterns.
- Enforces strict local reference usage for all SDK usage and queries—never use web search or external sources.
- Mandates official demo/sample project cloning for demos or prototypes; prohibits custom code until after a working baseline.
- Adds clear routing logic for product-specific and ambiguous requests, requiring intake for unclear queries.
- Includes guidance for server-side authentication, CLI workflows, and integration testing patterns.
